summary_en: TriIs Incorporated completed the acquisition of all issued shares of LIMNO Corporation for 600 million yen on October 1, 2026, acquiring 120,000 shares and establishing LIMNO as a wholly owned subsidiary with 100% voting control.
title_en: Notice Regarding Completion of Stock Acquisition (Establishment of Wholly Owned Subsidiary Status) of LIMNO Corporation
translation_en_brief:
On October 1, 2026, TriIs Incorporated completed the acquisition of all issued shares of LIMNO Corporation pursuant to a stock transfer agreement announced on September 15, 2026. The acquisition involved 120,000 shares for a total consideration of 600 million yen, with TriIs now holding 100% of LIMNO's voting rights and establishing it as a wholly owned subsidiary.

The financial impact of the acquisition on TriIs' consolidated operating results and financial position is currently under review, pending finalization of consolidation timing, purchase price allocation, accounting treatment including goodwill, post-acquisition capital support, and post-merger integration initiatives. TriIs stated it will promptly disclose any necessary revisions to earnings forecasts as further details are clarified.
